events.title: $3 Cans at Lux
events.description: Tallboys three bucks all night in the South Wedge.

events.title: The Social Reckoning
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 9 | Sixteen years on from The Social Network, writer-director Aaron Sorkin catches up with Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg (Jeremy Strong) as he attempts to deal with a whistleblowing data scientist (Mikey Madison) and a pesky journalist (Jeremy Allen White).

events.title: Digger
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 2 | From Alejandro G. Iñárritu (The Revenant, Birdman): The most powerful man in the world (Tom Cruise) embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

events.title: Never After Dark
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 9 | A medium helping lost souls cross over faces a powerful entity in an isolated house. Dark secrets emerge during her mission, transforming her spiritual work into a desperate struggle for survival.

events.title: The History of Concrete
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 2 | Filmmaker Jon Wilson applies lessons from a Hallmark movie writing workshop to pitch a documentary about concrete. A surreal, hysterical, and relatable film about America's favorite building material.

events.title: Industry Night
events.description: Service-industry pours and a late jukebox.
